name: experimental teaching
definition_zh: 通过实验活动组织知识与技能学习的教学形式。

complete_examples.text: At this time, the virtual simulation experiment teaching method can be used to achieve the effect of experimental teaching.
Virtual simulation teaching belongs to the modern Distributed under creative commons license 4.0 teaching mode, which is different from the experimental teaching mode of railway engineering.
